messages:
Emma R.: heads-up @channel — Parcelize onboarding seeing an error spike starting ~03:00 UTC. Quick numbers from the dashboard: 5xx rate 4.2% -> 12.5%, timeouts 0.3% -> 3.9%, rate_limit ~unchanged. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/parcelize/health

Priya S.: saw it, pulling logs now. looks like a cluster of 502/504s and some long tail requests (timeouts).

Marco L.: FYI we rolled a canary at 02:45 UTC on the inference config (batching + kv-cache tweak). Could be related. Reverting now.

Jenn K.: CS note — Parcelize is mid-onboard, ~1.2k MAU expected after full ramp next week. High visibility customer, flagged for renewal in 8 months.

Alex P.: temporary mitigation: reduce client retry loops and route to 1-smaller model variant if latency > 1.5s. Also throttle concurrent streams from their workspace.

Owen G.: created INC-2026 and tagged @eng-runtime and @eng-sre. I'll dump relevant logs here and start watching.

CS-Bot: alert: threshold breach for account=parcelize; 5xx_rate > 10% for 5m. auto-created incident INC-2026.

AlertBot: incident INC-2026 (parcelize) — severity: high — https://redwood.app/inc/INC-2026

Owen G.: log excerpt:
```
[03:01:12 UTC] POST /v1/generate 502 upstream_error model-runner-3 0.42s
[03:01:13 UTC] POST /v1/chat/stream 504 timeout kv-cache-miss 30.12s
[03:02:01 UTC] GET /v1/embeddings/batch 502 oom model-quantize-4 0.07s
[03:03:44 UTC] POST /v1/generate 504 timeout iteration=1 duration=25.89s
```

Priya S.: tagging Customer Notes — I'm drafting the outbound: short acknowledgement + we are investigating, ETA 30m. Will mention workaround (retries backoff) and ask them to pause bulk replays.

Marco L.: canary rollback in progress — kicked at 03:09 UTC. Reverting batching/kv-cache change. Will post when finished.

Emma R.: action items: 1) Marco — finish rollback + confirm metrics 2) Owen — validate root cause (deploy vs runtime) 3) Eng-runtime — consider emergency prefix caching or smaller model routing 4) Priya — customer outreach + note in renewal tracker 5) CS-Bot/AlertBot — keep incident open and alert on >5% 5xx.

Marco L.: rollback completed 03:12 UTC. metrics: 5xx now down to ~6.1% (still above baseline).

Owen G.: monitoring dashboards — error rate trending down, tail latency improving. keeping INC-2026 open until <1% sustained for 15m.

Priya S.: sent update to Parcelize: "we detected a spike, rolled back a canary, monitoring, recommended pause on bulk replays. Will follow up in 30m with resolution."

Jenn K.: added note to renewal risk board — flagged short-term operational risk, CS outreach logged.

Alex P.: once stable, recommend permanent change: pin parcelize to dedicated small-model variant for low-latency flows and enable per-account concurrency caps.

Emma R.: nice work team. please update INC-2026 with final RCA and customer-facing summary. Follow-up sync at 03:35 UTC if still degraded. :thumbsup:

Priya S.: will do. posting summary in ticket and sending a calendar invite for a 15m postmortem if needed.

Owen G.: will close incident when 5xx < 1% for 15m. current last check 03:18 UTC = 1.2%.
